expect_red: the band's sides: an unlit run before the lit span goes above and after it below, an interleaved piece goes to its nearer side, and a piece that forks off a lit node goes below

mutations.contract: An interleaved unlit piece that forks off a lit node goes below the band, whatever side it is nearer: above, it would have nothing to hang from.

mutations.contract: Below the band, an edge forking off a lit node is drawn after the node at its far end, so it curves to the band instead of running a rail through it.
